SEC:161:2026-27/MAA 
September 2, 2026 
 
The Manager - Listing  
National Stock Exchange of India Limited 
Capital Market – Listing 
Exchange Plaza, 5th Floor 
Plot No. C/1, G Block 
Bandra-Kurla Complex 
 
 
Bandra (E), Mumbai 400 051 
 
Dear Sir, 
 
Re: 
Disclosure under Reg. 30 read with Sch. III. Part A. Para A of SEBI (LODR) 
Regulations, 2015.  
 
We wish to inform you that today at 11.15 A.M., Mr. M. Ramaswamy, Chief Financial Officer 
and Ms. Bama Balakrishnan, Senior Vice President - Finance, had an interaction with 
PhillipCapital (India) Private Limited, institutional investor, regarding the performance of the 
Company.  It was a one-to-one interaction vide telecon. 
 
Further, we hereby confirm that:  
 
1. The interaction was primarily in the Q&A format. 
2. No Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (UPSI) was shared during the interaction.  
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours truly, 
For Sundaram Finance Limited 
 
 
 
 
P.N. Srikant 
CCO & Company Secretary 
 
P N 
SRIKANT
Digitally signed by 
P N SRIKANT
